meta.source: Channel Proposal Template 2026.pptx (PowerPoint export of the Google Slides deck 'Quote - Proposal Template 2026')
meta.canvas: Lengths are in px on a 720 x 405 canvas, where 1px equals 1pt in the source deck. Scale by canvas width / 720.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Slide background on content slides. The strip across the top of the cover.

tokens.name: grey
tokens.usage: All titles and body text, on white (5.1:1). On grey-pale it is 4.3:1, so keep text on grey-pale at 19px bold or larger. Also the right-hand panel of the logo mark.

tokens.name: grey-pale
tokens.usage: The strip across the top of content slides. The fill behind the cover background image.

tokens.name: grey-light
tokens.usage: A panel of the logo mark. Not used for text or fills in the source deck.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Brand red, from the logo mark. On white it is 4.4:1, so use it for shapes and for text at 19px bold or larger, never for small text.

tokens.name: red-dark
tokens.usage: The date on the cover, on white or grey-pale (6.1:1 and 5.1:1). The left-hand panel of the logo mark.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Link text, always underlined. On white it is 3.9:1, which is below 4.5:1 for the 8 to 11px links the source deck sets in it; the source value is kept exact. Also the base of the logo mark.

tokens.name: teal-light
tokens.usage: A panel of the logo mark. Shapes only, never text.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Followed-link colour in the source theme. Not seen on any slide.

tokens.name: ink-contact
tokens.usage: Punctuation beside the terms link on the Next Steps slide, on white. A stray value in the source, kept for fidelity; prefer grey.

tokens.name: ink-quote
tokens.usage: Testimonial quotes and their attributions, on white (16:1).

styles.name: cover-company
styles.usage: The client's company name on the cover, in capitals, in grey.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: The proposal or quote title under the company name, in capitals, in grey.

styles.name: cover-date
styles.usage: The date on the cover, in red-dark.

styles.name: header-meta
styles.usage: Company name and date repeated in the cover's top strip, in grey.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: The title of every content slide, in grey, left aligned.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: The master's default body size. The source slides override it to body.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Let us know if you'd like to chat further.
styles.usage: Body copy on content slides, in grey. Bold for names and field labels.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Channel Digital is a fantastic firm to work with.

styles.name: attribution
styles.usage: Who said a testimonial, bold, in ink-quote. Also the size of the footnote under the testimonials, set regular in grey.

styles.name: label-confidential
styles.usage: The word Confidential in the top-left of the cover strip. The only use of Raleway.

styles.name: slide-number
styles.usage: Slide number, bottom right, right aligned. The only use of Lato.

tokens.name: text-inset
tokens.usage: Padding inside every text box (7.2pt in the source).

tokens.name: strip-half
tokens.usage: Half the top strip. The tile size on the system's cover.

tokens.name: strip-height
tokens.usage: Height of the strip across the top of every slide (9.5% of slide height).

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of the title and body (8% of slide width).

tokens.name: title-top
tokens.usage: Distance from the top of the slide to the title box (25.6% of slide height).

tokens.name: body-top
tokens.usage: Distance from the top of the slide to the body box (40.4% of slide height).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every shape in the deck is square cornered.
